beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: Christian walked on along the King's Highway. The sun was shining and the flowers nodded in the breeze. But oh, how heavy his burden was!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: I've carried it through the mud, and past the mountain, and through the little gate. And still it weighs me down.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Just a little further... just a little further up this hill.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: At the top of the hill stood a Cross. And a little below it, on the slope, was an open tomb.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: The Cross... So this is the place I was told about.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Wait! Something is moving. The straps... they're coming loose, all on their own!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: The burden tumbled down the hill, rolled into the mouth of the tomb, and was never seen again.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: It's gone... It's truly gone! All this way I carried it, and here, it fell off by itself!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: It wasn't anything I did. Jesus carried my guilt for me. He has given me rest by His sorrow, and life by His death.
beats.say: It wasn't anything I did. Jesus carried my guilt for me. He has given me rest by his sorrow, and life by his death.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: He hung here in my place, carrying everything I had carried all my life. I can never repay this. I can only walk on, and never forget.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: He looked, and looked again, until happy tears ran down his cheeks.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: Then Christian went softly down to the tomb, and peeped inside. It was empty.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: My burden tumbled in here, and it's gone. Jesus took it all into the grave with Him. And then, He came out again!
beats.say: My burden tumbled in here, and it's gone. Jesus took it all into the grave with him. And then, he came out again!

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: The empty tomb is the proof that it was enough. He rose... and my guilt did not!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: Then three Shining Ones came down to him, bright as the morning.

beats.speaker: First Shining One
beats.text: Peace be with you, Christian. Your sins are forgiven.

beats.speaker: Second Shining One
beats.text: I take away your worn and dusty clothes... and dress you in new ones, clean and shining.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Oh! They're beautiful! Are they really for me?

beats.speaker: Third Shining One
beats.text: And I set this mark upon your forehead, and give you a sealed scroll.

beats.speaker: Third Shining One
beats.text: Read it as you travel, to comfort you on the way. And hand it in at the gate of the Celestial City. It is the King's own promise that you belong to Him.
beats.say: Read it as you travel, to comfort you on the way. And hand it in at the gate of the Celestial City. It is the King's own promise, that you belong to him.

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: And just as gently as they had come, the Shining Ones were gone.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Forgiven... clothed... and sealed! I came up this hill bent double, and I will go down it singing!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: So Christian gave three leaps for joy, and went on his way, singing.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.text: Blest Cross! Blest tomb! And blessed most of all, the One who there was put to shame for me!

beats.speaker: Narrator
beats.text: His back was straight, his steps were light, and the whole world looked new. Down the hill he went, toward the shining light.
